sceneDescription: On a supermarket checkout belt, a gold credit card is perched upright on a classic jewelry ring display stand, flanked by a tangle of plastic shopping bags and a chunky gold ring balanced atop a barcode scanner. To the side, a shopping basket holds a point-of-sale terminal snuggled between apples and a fashionably boxed jewelry cleaner. The absurdity comes from luxury and payment items adopting each other's display roles, blurring commerce and opulence in a mundane setting. Subtle 'Digital Commerce 360' and 'Jeweller' logos peek from bag tags and a jewelry box sticker.
